56835991.name: RO5263397
56835991.description: RO5263397, or RO-5263397, is a trace amine-associated receptor 1 partial or full agonist which is used in scientific research.

56843415.name: Miravirsen
56843415.description: Miravirsen is an experimental drug for the treatment of hepatitis C, being developed by Santaris Pharma.

70957463.name: Flortaucipir (18F)
70957463.description: Flortaucipir , sold under the brand name Tauvid, is a radioactive diagnostic agent indicated for use with positron emission tomography imaging to image the brain.

71308183.name: Dimethylamidophosphoric dicyanide
71308183.description: Dimethylamidophosphoric dicyanide is an important chemical for the final process of synthesizing Tabun, a nerve agent used as a chemical weapon.

71587735.name: Lutetium (177Lu) oxodotreotide
71587735.description: Lutetium oxodotreotide or 177Lu dotatate, brand name Lutathera, is a chelated complex of a radioisotope of the element lutetium with dotatate, used in peptide receptor radionuclide therapy.

71727383.name: Merigolix
71727383.description: Merigolix (INNTooltip International Nonproprietary Name; developmental code names HS-10518, NCE-403, SKI-2670, TU-2670) is a gonadotropin releasing hormone antagonist which is under development for...

76959255.name: Lotilaner
76959255.description: Lotilaner, sold under the brand name Xdemvy, is an ectoparasiticide medication used for the treatment of blepharitis caused by infestation by Demodex .

87815447.name: Cartalax
87815447.description: Cartalax is a tripeptide derivative developed in Russia.

91663255.name: Iron sucrose
91663255.description: Intravenous iron sucrose, sold under the brand name Venofer is a treatment used for iron-deficiency anemia.

118796439.name: FUB-144
118796439.description: FUB-144 is an indole-based synthetic cannabinoid that is presumed to be a potent agonist of the CB1 receptor and has been sold online as a designer drug.

129696023.name: Lanthanum laurate
129696023.description: Lanthanum laurate is a metal-organic compound with the chemical formula C36H72LaO6. The compound is classified as a metallic soap, i.e. a metal derivative of a fatty acid .

132042903.name: Balinatunfib
132042903.description: Balinatunfib is an experimental drug which acts as a potent small molecule inhibitor of TNF.

134817175.name: BU09059
134817175.description: BU09059 is a potent, selective, short-acting antagonist of the κ-opioid receptor .

135567383.name: CU-CPT9a
135567383.description: CU-CPT9a is a drug which acts as a potent and selective antagonist of Toll-like receptor 8 , with an IC50 of 0.5nM.

137323799.name: Wuhanic acid
137323799.description: Wuhanic acid ( -7,18-dihydroxytetracosa-15,21-dienoic acid) is a 24-carbon dihydroxy fatty acid with the chemical formula C24H44O4 and molecular weight 396.6 g/mol.

139051543.name: TKX-50
139051543.description: TKX-50 is the chemical compound with the formula C2H8N10O4; it is a hydroxylammonium salt of 5,5′-bistetrazolyl-1,1′-diolate that forms colorless crystals, and it is a high-performing explosive with...

156596375.name: Fosgonimeton
156596375.description: Fosgonimeton is an investigational new drug that is being evaluated to treat neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease.

165360151.name: EA-2054
165360151.description: EA-2054 is an extremely toxic organophosphate nerve agent. It is an extremely potent acetylcholinesterase inhibitor that is resistant to atropine and oxime treatment.

165365655.name: Potassium nonahydridorhenate
165365655.description: Potassium nonahydridorhenate is an inorganic compound having the formula K2[ReH9].

171074967.name: Vepugratinib
171074967.description: Vepugratinib is an investigational new drug that is being evaluated by Loxo Oncology for the treatment of genitourinary cancer. It is a fibroblast growth factor receptor 3 antagonist.

172871959.name: ADB-5'F-BUTINACA
172871959.description: ADB-5'F-BUTINACA is an indazole-3-carboxamide based synthetic cannabinoid receptor agonist.

175666967.name: CDD-2807
175666967.description: CDD-2807 is a chemical compound which acts as a potent and selective inhibitor of serine/threonine-protein kinase 33 , with a IC50 of 9.2 nM.

176491927.name: Z8779877149
176491927.description: Z8779877149 is an indole derivative which acts at multiple targets, being a potent and selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor , an agonist of the α2A adrenergic receptor, and a 5-HT2A receptor agonist.

900000023.name: 2-Chloromescaline
900000023.description: 2-Chloromescaline , also known as 2-chloro-3,4,5-trimethoxyphenethylamine, is a serotonin receptor modulator of the scaline family related to mescaline.

900000151.name: Amlenetug
900000151.description: Amlenetug (INNTooltip International Nonproprietary Name, USANTooltip United States Adopted Name; developmental code name Lu AF82422) is a monoclonal antibody against α-synuclein which is under...

900000407.name: Candelilla wax
900000407.description: Candelilla wax is a wax derived from the leaves of the small candelilla shrub native to northern Mexico and the southwestern United States, Euphorbia antisyphilitica, from the family Euphorbiaceae.

900000663.name: EA-5488
900000663.description: EA-5488 is an extremely toxic organophosphate nerve agent related to GV. It appears to have less than half the toxicity of the VX agent.

900000791.name: Europium(II) titanate
900000791.description: Europium titanate is a black mixed oxide of europium and titanium, with the chemical formula of EuTiO3. It crystallizes in the perovskite structure.

900001047.name: Isoceteth-20
900001047.description: Isoceteth-20 is a polyethylene glycol ether formed by the ethoxylation of isocetyl alcohol ; with the general formula HO nC16H33 where n has an average value of 20.

900001303.name: N-terminal telopeptide
900001303.description: The N-terminal telopeptide , also known as amino-terminal collagen crosslinks, is the N-terminal telopeptide of fibrillar collagens such as collagen type I and type II.

900001431.name: Ontuxizumab
900001431.description: Ontuxizumab is a humanized rabbit monoclonal antibody designed for the treatment of cancer.

900001687.name: Potassium humate
900001687.description: Potassium humate is the potassium salt of humic acid. It is manufactured commercially by alkaline extraction of brown coal leonardite and is used mainly as a soil conditioner.

900001815.name: Rubidium germanium iodide
900001815.description: Rubidium germanium iodide is a ternary halide of rubidium and germanium, with the chemical formula RbGeI3.

900001943.name: Swinholide
900001943.description: Swinholides are dimeric 42 carbon-ring polyketides that exhibit a 2-fold axis of symmetry.

900002071.name: Trichlorostannate
900002071.description: Trichlorostannate is the inorganic anion with the formula SnCl−3.

900002199.name: ZSP1601
900002199.description: ZSP1601 is an experimental pan-phosphodiesterase inhibitor developed by Guangdong Raynovent Biotech for nonalcoholic steatohepatitis.
